items.title: Track thumbnails with Git LFS
items.goal: Add the thumbs/*.png LFS rule to .gitattributes.
acceptance: .gitattributes keeps the assets/*.png rule and adds thumbs/*.png filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text.
nonGoals: Images, gallery.json and a global binary rule.

validation.command: git check-attr filter -- thumbs/source.png | grep -qx 'thumbs/source.png: filter: lfs'

items.brief: Append the thumbs/*.png LFS rule from the cited section to .gitattributes, keeping the existing rule.

items.title: Generate and list the reference thumbnail
items.goal: Produce two candidate thumbnail sets for assets/source.png and list the selected thumbnail in gallery.json.
acceptance: Two complete candidate sets each bind an image role to thumbs/source.png and a metadata role to thumbs/source.json whose source is assets/source.png.
gallery.json gives assets/source.png the thumb thumbs/source.png.
nonGoals: Changing assets/source.png or committing candidate bytes directly.
items.brief: Stage two candidate sets under .factory-media/ from the reference asset: a PNG of at most 64x64 for thumbs/source.png and a JSON sidecar thumbs/source.json naming source and generator. Add the thumb field to gallery.json.
